description: This file is the main HTML for a web-based database viewer interface, including embedded CSS styles and JavaScript code that manages database and table selection, data fetching, and displaying data in a sortable and expandable table format.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches list of databases from the server and populates the sidebar menu.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases, resets the current selection, and updates the UI.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses a database to show its tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches tables for a selected database and displays them in the sidebar.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches data for a selected table and renders it in the main content area.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Builds and displays an HTML table with fetched data.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Creates a table cell for a given data value, handling different data types and long content.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses a cell to show full content, useful for long text or objects.
